objective: Standing-lease lifecycle on the existing objects: one ceremony mints, RuntimePolicyLeaseSnapshot renders the spend envelope as a read projection, revoke refuses the very next draw, and recovery or replay never widens, resets or resurrects a lease.
falsifiable_claim: npm run check:standing-lease-lifecycle pins the wallet lifecycle tests (2), the single-use ceremony test and the policy-lease projection tests (2) by exact name, pins from source that the projection exists and only subtracts and that reservations stay monotonic on settlement; npm run mutate:standing-lease-lifecycle plants a revoke that leaves the lease Active, a projection that reports the full allowance after draws, and a replay that resets the counters, and each must turn the check red.
adversarial_or_fault_proof: The mutate: drill plants three production-source defects and requires the unit check to go red for each, restoring the original bytes in every exit path; the check itself is a fail-empty exact-name population (a renamed or deleted test is red).
remaining_nonclaims: No daemon route serves RuntimePolicyLeaseSnapshot yet and the standing entry has no registered wire contract; no surface claims it (G-4) until one is registered — the Connections card in M13.3 is the first intended consumer.
Recovery is proven over the durable state bytes (a fresh state built from them) and over the idempotent re-record; a physical device-transition ceremony is not exercised here.
source_provenance: Landed 2026-09-08 by the standing-authority consumer-loop program, leg 2; recorded in canon-to-code-delta.md § Journey verification XX.
